item_name: Rothco Deluxe Low Pro Shadow Cap / Army Eagle
item_short_desc: Show your support in style with Rothco’s Deluxe Low Pro Shadow Cap featuring the iconic Army Eagle design. This low-profile cap displays raised “ARMY” text embroidered in bold black, outlined with crisp white thread, on the front panel. The intricate eagle shadow embroidery adds a striking touch of detail. Additional “ARMY” branding is featured on the brim, both sewn and printed, for a standout look. Made from 100% brushed cotton twill, the cap combines durability with lightweight comfort.
description: Show your support in style with Rothco’s Deluxe Low Pro Shadow Cap featuring the iconic Army Eagle design. This low-profile cap displays raised “ARMY” text embroidered in bold black, outlined with crisp white thread, on the front panel. Perfect for veterans, supporters, or those who want to proudly display their appreciation, this cap is as functional as it is stylish.
